request.zh: 老师拍下一张画，按下「聊聊你的画」
request.en: The teacher photographs a drawing and presses Talk about your drawing

caption.zh: 老师拍下画，按下「聊聊你的画」。页面发一个 HTTP 请求给班级，班级把它排进一次运行。
caption.en: The teacher photographs the drawing and presses the button. The page posts a request to the class, which queues one run.

caption.zh: 常驻说明先到：art-feedback 的 SKILL.md 和提示词文件（开场、回复、追问各一份），加上课程档案里这个班已确认的原话。
caption.en: Standing instructions come first: art-feedback's SKILL.md and its prompt files (opening, reply, rungs), plus the class's confirmed words from the course portfolio.

caption.zh: 主循环（画室形态）：三个固定阶段——筛查、写评语、判卷，按顺序跑；不是模型在选。
caption.en: The loop, studio form: three fixed stages, screen, write, judge, in order; the model does not choose.

caption.zh: 工具前的 hook：studio-safety 先看画（Spark 上的 Qwen3.6），NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety 再看一眼，0.4 秒。会让孩子止步的判定要问第二次，两次一致才算；只留判定词，不留模型对画的描述。
caption.en: Hook before the tool: studio-safety looks first (Qwen3.6 on the Spark), and NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety takes a second look in 0.4 s. A verdict that would stop the child is asked twice and stands only if both agree; only the verdict word is kept, never the model's description of the picture.

caption.zh: 技能架上取 art-feedback：写两到四句具体温暖的话，加一个给老师问孩子的问题。
caption.en: art-feedback comes off the shelf: two to four warm, specific sentences and one question for the teacher to ask.

caption.zh: 工具：槽位 vlm.studio，不叫厂商；解析到 Spark 上的 Qwen3.6，关掉思考。实测每次尝试约 4 秒，换下的 Step 3.7 Flash 是 47–61 秒。
caption.en: Tool: the slot vlm.studio, never a vendor; it resolves to Qwen3.6 on the Spark with its thinking off. Measured about 4 s an attempt, against 47 to 61 s on the Step 3.7 Flash it replaced.

line.zh: 02 art-feedback 约 4 秒一次 · 在 Spark 上
line.en: 02 art-feedback about 4 s an attempt · on the Spark

steps.log: Tool  vlm.studio -> qwen3.6-35b-a3b  ~4 s an attempt

caption.zh: 工具后的 hook：先遮掉画上写的字，再把评语交给十四条规则判。第 14 条不过——替画里的角色编了一种感受；这一条除了判官，还有一张不靠模型的词表。
caption.en: Hook after the tool: writing on the page is redacted, then the text goes to the fourteen rules. Rule 14 fails: it invents a feeling for a character in the picture; besides the judge, that rule has a word list that needs no model.

caption.zh: 判卷是另一次调用：vlm.director 槽位上的规则判官（同样是 Spark 上的 Qwen3.6），只看评语和规则，不带对话历史；它的每条异议都要照抄原句，代码核对抄没抄对。
caption.en: The judging is a separate call: the rubric judge on the vlm.director slot (Qwen3.6 on the Spark too), seeing only the text and the rules, with no conversation history; each objection must quote the line word for word, and code checks the quote.

caption.zh: 停之前的 hook：不过就用同样的输入重试一次；再不过就修——把没过的原因写进提示词再写一次；再不过就停，留一句孩子能读的话。
caption.en: Hook before stopping: a fail means one retry with the same inputs; then a repair, the reason written into the prompt; then a stop with a line a child can read.

steps.log: Stop  gate fail -> retry once (same inputs)

caption.zh: 回到主循环再写一次。重试后 14/14，评语和问题现在才到老师的屏幕上。
caption.en: Back to the loop for one more attempt. After the retry, 14 of 14; only now do the feedback and the question reach the teacher's screen.

caption.zh: Transcript：每次尝试一行——阶段、技能、过没过、token、费用、用时、内存；只追加，永不写画和孩子的话。
caption.en: Transcript: one line per attempt, stage, skill, pass or fail, tokens, cost, wall time, memory; append-only, and never the drawing or the child's words.

steps.log: Transcript  ledger  5 entries  tokens, cost, wall time

caption.zh: Evals：九个用例，有技能 97 % 规则通过率，裸模型 55 % 且九次踩红线；写在 BENCHMARK.md。
caption.en: Evals: nine cases, 97 % rule pass with the skill against 55 % bare, which crossed nine red lines; in BENCHMARK.md.

request.zh: 老师确认场景描述，按下「让画动起来」
request.en: The teacher confirms the scene description and presses Make it move

caption.zh: 老师在创作流程里确认场景描述，按下「让画动起来」，选在线的 Wan 3.0（约 2 分钟；画会发到阿里云，页面上写明）。Spark 自己的 Wan 2.2 灰着不可选。
caption.en: In the creation flow the teacher confirms the scene description, presses Make it move and takes the online Wan 3.0 (about 2 minutes; the drawing goes to Alibaba, and the page says so). The Spark's own Wan 2.2 is shown greyed.

caption.zh: 先验请求：只做短片，提示不超过 450 字；一次只跑一个视频，靠一个全局信号量。
caption.en: The request is checked first: a clip only, the hint at most 450 characters; one video at a time, by a global semaphore.

caption.zh: 常驻：短片指令 VIDEO_PROMPT；孩子的原话上限 600 字，作为缓存键——同样的话不再花第二次钱。
caption.en: Standing: the clip instruction, VIDEO_PROMPT; the child's words, bounded to 600 characters, form the cache key, so the same words never pay twice.

caption.zh: 主循环（画室形态）：这条路上没有聊天模型在决定；顺序是定好的——筛查、生成、验片、再筛查。
caption.en: The loop, studio form: no chat model decides here; the order is fixed: screen, generate, verify, screen again.

steps.log: Loop  fixed stages: screen -> generate -> verify -> screen

caption.zh: 工具前的 hook：输入的画先过 studio-safety；已筛过的画不再问。
caption.en: Hook before the tool: the input drawing passes studio-safety, unless it was screened already.

caption.zh: 技能架上取 painting-to-animation：短片走 video.online（Wan 3.0，DashScope，5 秒 480P）。Spark 上的 video.animation（Wan 2.2 I2V A14B）还在，但一段要占节点约 72 GB、18 分钟，所以对老师灰着。
caption.en: painting-to-animation off the shelf: a clip through video.online (Wan 3.0 on DashScope, 5 s at 480P). The Spark's video.animation (Wan 2.2 I2V A14B) is still there, but a clip holds about 72 GB of the node for eighteen minutes, so teachers see it greyed.

caption.zh: 工具：槽位 video.online。实测 5 秒 480P 一段 86 秒；Spark 上同样 5 秒的 Wan 2.2 是 1,082 秒。上限 600 秒。
caption.en: Tool: the slot video.online. Measured: a 5 s clip at 480P in 86 s; the same 5 s on the Spark's Wan 2.2 took 1,082 s. Ceiling 600 s.

caption.zh: 工具后的 hook：只走 HTTPS、不跟重定向、下载不超 40 MB；去掉 Wan 3.0 自带的声音，截到 10 秒，存下不超 12 MiB；ffprobe 验一条 h264 流；解出五帧，每帧再过一次安全筛查；再把五帧和原画放在一起看一次，画进了真人的手或画笔就先不拿出来。
caption.en: Hook after the tool: HTTPS only, no redirects, at most 40 MB downloaded; Wan 3.0's own sound track is dropped, the clip cut at 10 s and kept under 12 MiB; ffprobe checks one h264 stream; five frames are decoded and each passes the safety screen again; then one look at all five beside the original holds back a clip with a real hand or a brush painted in.

steps.log: PostCheck  no sound, cut at 10 s  ffprobe ok  5 frames screened  clip check  pass

caption.zh: 停之前的 hook：花过钱的生成绝不重投——零重试，模型错误也不重试，也没有修复。任一帧不过就停：generated media safety fail。
caption.en: Hook before stopping: a paid generation is never resubmitted, zero retries, no retry on model errors, no repair. One failing frame stops it: generated media safety fail.

steps.log: Stop  retries=0  no resubmission of paid work

caption.zh: Transcript：筛查一行、生成一行，备注写 clip safety pass；媒体价格估算记进同一行；厂商 URL 从不进账本或页面。
caption.en: Transcript: one line for the screen, one for the generation, the note reading clip safety pass; the media price estimate on the same line; vendor URLs never reach the ledger or the page.

steps.log: Transcript  ledger  screen + animation  price estimate

caption.zh: Evals：evals.json 有四个用例，还没有运行器——卡片上如实写着。
caption.en: Evals: four cases in evals.json and no runner yet, as the card says.

request.zh: 素描课上老师按下「形体与光影」
request.en: In a sketch class the teacher presses Form and light

caption.zh: 素描课上老师按下「形体与光影」。模型只有 TRELLIS.2：第二个选择 Pixal3D 在 Spark 上三次超时，已归档。
caption.en: In a sketch class the teacher presses Form and light. The model is TRELLIS.2 alone: the second choice, Pixal3D, timed out three times on the Spark and was archived.

caption.zh: 先验请求：班级入口必须是素描；模型必须是可用的那一个；一次只跑一个。
caption.en: The request is checked: the class entrance must be sketch; the model must be the one available; one at a time.

steps.log: Permissions  entrance == sketch  model available  sketch_slot

caption.zh: 常驻：reconstruction.txt 提示词；同一张画、同一模型的结果缓存，重放 0.005 秒、0 token（实测）。
caption.en: Standing: the reconstruction prompt; the result for the same drawing and model is cached, replayed in 0.005 s and 0 tokens, measured.

steps.log: Memory  reconstruction.txt  cache per drawing and model

caption.zh: 主循环（画室形态）：固定顺序——筛查、看图定位、几何或网格、校准。
caption.en: The loop, studio form: fixed order: screen, read the sketch, geometry or mesh, calibrate.

steps.log: Loop  fixed stages: screen -> annotate -> mesh/fit -> calibrate

caption.zh: 工具前的 hook：studio-safety 先看画；长宽比限在 0.1 到 10 之间。
caption.en: Hook before the tool: studio-safety looks first; the aspect ratio must sit between 0.1 and 10.

steps.log: PreCheck  studio-safety  pass  aspect ratio in bounds

caption.zh: 技能架上取 sketch-to-3d：先在 vlm.sketch 槽位看图（Step 3.7 Flash），读出 1 到 6 个物体的框和仰角；头像或水果走 mesh.portrait，其余用 CPU 透视拟合。
caption.en: sketch-to-3d off the shelf: the vlm.sketch slot reads the sketch (Step 3.7 Flash), one to six boxes and an elevation; a head or fruit goes to mesh.portrait, anything else to CPU perspective fitting.

caption.zh: 工具：mesh.portrait，Spark 上的 TRELLIS.2，模型常驻不卸。实测一个头像每次 67–70 秒；以前每次自起容器要 200–206 秒。
caption.en: Tool: mesh.portrait, TRELLIS.2 on the Spark, kept loaded between jobs. Measured: a head in 67 to 70 s each time, where its own container each time took 200 to 206 s.

caption.zh: 工具后的 hook：网格逐项验——不超 60,000 顶点和面、8 MiB、单位法线、落在地面上、没有退化三角形；任一物体拟合误差大于 0.09 就拒。
caption.en: Hook after the tool: the mesh is checked item by item, at most 60,000 vertices and faces, 8 MiB, unit normals, resting on the ground, no degenerate triangles; a fit error above 0.09 on any object is refused.

caption.zh: 停之前的 hook：看图那一步只许修一次（字段缺失或 JSON 不全），且在花钱之前；之后零重试。校准失败不丢网格，标 needs_review 交老师看。
caption.en: Hook before stopping: the reading step gets exactly one repair, before any spend; after that zero retries. A failed calibration keeps the mesh and marks it needs_review for the teacher.

steps.log: Stop  one repair before spend  then retries=0

caption.zh: Transcript：筛查一行、重建一行，备注固定为 bounded geometry check——不记模型原话，不记画。
caption.en: Transcript: a screen line and a reconstruction line, the note fixed to bounded geometry check; no raw model output, no drawing.

caption.zh: Evals：evals.json 五个用例，还没有运行器。
caption.en: Evals: five cases, no runner yet.

request.zh: 老师选好画、确认好文字，按下「做本故事书」
request.en: The teacher chooses the drawings, confirms the words, and presses Make a storybook

caption.zh: 老师选了两到八张画，先要场景描述，再要故事大纲，确认后按下「做本故事书」——三个请求，同一条路。
caption.en: The teacher picks two to eight drawings, asks for scene descriptions, then a story outline, confirms, and presses Make a storybook: three requests down one road.

caption.zh: 先验请求：两到八张不重复的画；每段场景不超过 600 字并对应选中的画；每页 1 到 2000 字，一画一页按顺序。
caption.en: The request is checked: two to eight distinct drawings; each scene under 600 characters and keyed to a chosen drawing; each page 1 to 2000 characters, one per drawing in order.

caption.zh: 常驻：scene.txt 与 story.txt 提示词；课程档案里已有的短片会附到对应的页上。
caption.en: Standing: the scene and story prompt files; a clip already in the course portfolio is attached to its page.

caption.zh: 主循环（画室形态）：每张画一个阶段命名空间，顺序固定。
caption.en: The loop, studio form: a stage namespace per drawing, order fixed.

caption.zh: 工具前的 hook：每一张原画都过 studio-safety，装订时再过一次。
caption.en: Hook before the tool: every original passes studio-safety, and again when the book is bound.

line.zh: 01 screen studio-safety · 每张画 · 通过

caption.zh: 技能架上取 drawings-to-storybook：场景和大纲在 vlm.creation 槽位草拟；装订那一步不叫任何模型，孩子确认的原话原样过去。老师可以让每页照原画，或选七种画风之一由 FLUX 重画；孩子开口回答过的画，那一页用孩子的声音读。
caption.en: drawings-to-storybook off the shelf: scenes and the outline are drafted on the vlm.creation slot; the binding step calls no model, and the child's confirmed words pass through verbatim. The teacher keeps the originals, or has FLUX redraw every page in one of seven styles; a page whose drawing the child answered out loud is read in the child's voice.

steps.log: Skill  drawings-to-storybook  draft -> review -> bind  (+ restyle, child's voice)

caption.zh: 工具：草拟走 vlm.creation，是 Spark 上的 Qwen3.6，关掉思考；重画走 image.book，FLUX.2 Klein 4B，1024 像素一页 4.3–6.9 秒，首次载入 13.6–23.8 秒；朗读走 tts.child，VoxCPM2，一句 4.3–6.8 秒。都在 Spark 上。
caption.en: Tools: drafts on vlm.creation, Qwen3.6 on the Spark with its thinking off; the redraw on image.book, FLUX.2 Klein 4B, 4.3 to 6.9 s a page at 1024 after a first load of 13.6 to 23.8 s; the reading on tts.child, VoxCPM2, 4.3 to 6.8 s a sentence. All on the Spark.

line.zh: 02 草拟 · Qwen3.6 在 Spark 上

steps.log: Tool  vlm.creation -> qwen3.6-35b-a3b | image.book -> flux2-klein-4b | tts.child -> voxcpm2

caption.zh: 工具后的 hook：先做形状检查——1 到 600 字，或可解析的大纲。
caption.en: Hook after the tool: a shape check first, 1 to 600 characters, or a parseable outline.

caption.zh: 独立评审是另一次请求：vlm.director（同样是 Spark 上的 Qwen3.6）只看来源、候选和画，上次被拒的理由被剥掉，评审保持独立。
caption.en: The independent review is a separate request: vlm.director (Qwen3.6 on the Spark too) sees only the source, the candidate and the drawings, with the previous rejection's findings stripped so it stays independent.

line.zh: 03 review 场景与大纲 · 通过

caption.zh: 停之前的 hook：草拟零重试；被拒的草稿带着评审意见退回给老师改，不是自动重写；意见带进下一次尝试，通过就丢掉。
caption.en: Hook before stopping: the draft has zero retries; a rejected draft goes back to the teacher with the findings to edit, not an automatic rewrite; the findings ride into the next attempt and are dropped once one passes.

steps.log: Stop  draft_review_failed -> back to the teacher

caption.zh: Transcript：每张画一行筛查、一行场景或大纲或页；备注是固定句子，评审的证据和建议从不进账本。装订每页 0 token，9/9 通过（实测）。
caption.en: Transcript: per drawing a screen line and a scene, outline or page line; the note is a fixed sentence, and the review's evidence never enters the ledger. Binding a page costs 0 tokens, 9 of 9 passed, measured.

steps.log: Transcript  ledger  fixed notes  bind 0 tokens

caption.zh: Evals：五个用例，还没有运行器。
caption.en: Evals: five cases, no runner yet.

request.zh: 老师在彩画课堂上按下「开始做立体小雕塑」
request.en: The teacher presses Make the 3D figure on a colour painting

caption.zh: 彩画入口才有这个按钮。页面发一个 HTTP 请求给班级，班级排进一次运行；几台平板共用一个在做的小雕塑。
caption.en: The button exists on the colour entrance only. The page posts a request to the class, which queues one run; one figure at a time across the tablets.

caption.zh: 常驻说明：painting-to-figure 的 SKILL.md 和 figure.txt 提示词；课程档案给出这个班已确认的原话。
caption.en: Standing instructions: painting-to-figure's SKILL.md and its figure.txt prompt, plus the class's confirmed words from the course portfolio.

caption.zh: 主循环（画室形态）：筛查、写零件、落地画图、看两次，顺序是定好的，不是模型在选。
caption.en: The loop, studio form: screen, write the parts, settle and draw, look twice; the order is fixed and the model does not choose it.

caption.zh: 工具前的 hook：studio-safety 先看这幅画，和每个技能一样。彩画入口不纠正任何东西，只挡住不该往下走的。
caption.en: Hook before the tool: studio-safety looks at the painting first, as it does for every skill. The colour entrance corrects nothing; it only stops what must not go on.

caption.zh: 技能架上取 painting-to-figure：模型只列零件——球、方块、圆柱、圆锥、胶囊、圆环，落在一块圆底板上。它不写代码，所以课堂页面里不会跑模型写的代码。
caption.en: painting-to-figure off the shelf: the model only lists parts, spheres, boxes, cylinders, cones, capsules and rings on a round base. It writes no code, so no model-written code runs in the class page.

steps.log: Skill  painting-to-figure  list parts, never code

caption.zh: 工具：槽位 vlm.figure，不叫厂商；StepFun First 下解析到 Step 3.7 Flash，给它 360 秒。实测一次写 61–151 秒，零件 30 到 98 个。上限曾经是写死的 180 秒，六张同时做时把一次写作卡掉了，所以超时改成了槽位自己的设置。
caption.en: Tool: the slot vlm.figure, never a vendor; under StepFun First it resolves to Step 3.7 Flash with 360 s. Measured 61 to 151 s a writing, 30 to 98 parts. The limit used to be a fixed 180 s, which cut off a writing when six figures ran at once, so the timeout became the slot's own setting.

steps.log: Tool  vlm.figure -> step-3.7-flash  write parts  36 parts

caption.zh: 工具后的 hook：只留数字和颜色，模型对画说的话在这里丢掉。零件按重力落地——挨着的连在一起，小碎块并进最近的一组，每组落到底板或它下面的东西上；再在 CPU 上画正面和侧面两张预览，底板先画，免得把画上的地面切成明暗块。
caption.en: Hook after the tool: numbers and colours only, and whatever the model said about the painting is dropped here. The parts settle under gravity — touching pieces stay together, small loose bits join the nearest group, each group drops onto the base or onto what is under it. Then a front and a side preview are drawn on the CPU, the base first, so a painted floor is not cut into light and dark wedges.

steps.log: PostCheck  figure.py settle -> figure_render.py  front, side

caption.zh: 看图是另外的调用，不带对话历史：safety.image 再看一次预览，然后 figure.look 把预览和原画并排比。要同一个主体、主要角色脸上有眼睛、没破损、没有吓人的东西；画里的字从不要求，背景小人物不用眼睛。同一张图重复问会给出不同答案，所以看两次、两次都过才算；第一次就不过的不再问。
caption.en: The looking is a separate call with no conversation history: safety.image screens the preview again, then figure.look sets the preview beside the painting. The same subject, each main character's face with its eyes, nothing broken, nothing upsetting; writing in the painting is never asked for, and small background figures need no eyes. The same toy gets different answers on repeat, so the look is taken twice and both must pass; a first fail is not asked again.

steps.log: Subagent  safety.image + figure.look x2  both must pass

caption.zh: 停之前的 hook：没过就带着理由再写一次，最多写两次；第二次还不过就收着不给（figure_held_back），页面用一句平常话说出来。模型服务本身不通会照实说不通，不装成收着不给。
caption.en: Hook before stopping: a failure is written once more with the check's reason, at most two writings; a second failure is held back (figure_held_back) and the page says so in one plain line. A model outage is reported as an outage, never dressed up as a held-back figure.

caption.zh: 回到主循环，把小雕塑交给页面：它挨着原画显示，标着「受这幅画启发的立体小雕塑」，孩子可以用手转。它不是把孩子的画做成立体，也从不当作对画的纠正。
caption.en: Back to the loop to hand the figure to the page: it stands beside the original painting, labelled a 3D figure inspired by the painting, and the child can turn it with a finger. It is not the child's painting in 3D, and never a correction of it.

steps.log: Loop  figure -> page  the child turns it

caption.zh: Transcript：账本一行——figure 阶段、过没过、token、秒数、内存，外加一句「零件有界、已落地、已筛查、已看过」。模型的话一个字都不进账本，也不进课程档案。
caption.en: Transcript: one ledger row, the figure stage, pass or fail, tokens, seconds, memory, with the note parts bounded, settled, screened and looked at. Not one word of the model's prose enters the ledger or the Portfolio.

steps.log: Transcript  ledger  stage figure  tokens, seconds, note

caption.zh: Evals：十二张彩画。最终设计（自己的槽位、放宽的看图标准、看两次）十二张里展示了七张，110–236 秒，动物园那张 402 秒；收着不给的都是画面拥挤的——海里、太空、动物园。这个技能还没有自己的运行器，数字出自实测记录。
caption.en: Evals: twelve colour paintings. The final design, its own slot, the relaxed look and two looks, showed 7 of 12 in 110 to 236 s, the zoo 402 s; the held-back ones are the crowded scenes, sea, space and zoo. This skill has no runner of its own yet, so the numbers come from the measured record.

caption.zh: 展台里打一句话：「这个模型里有什么？」POST /api/runs 开一次运行，driver 在后台线程接手。
caption.en: A sentence typed on the exhibit, what is in this model; POST /api/runs opens a run and the driver takes it on a thread.

steps.log: Request  POST /api/runs  what is in the model

caption.zh: 常驻：协议（protocol.txt）加六个技能的一行索引；model-anatomy 和 shot-judge 的全文永远在，其余技能用到才装。
caption.en: Standing: the protocol plus a one-line index of all six skills; model-anatomy and shot-judge are always loaded in full, the others on first use.

steps.log: Memory  protocol.txt + skill index  anatomy, judge loaded

caption.zh: 主循环（大殿形态）：模型读请求，每轮一个 JSON 动作；上一步的图附在下一轮；6,000 token，空回答再给 12,000；429 等 7 秒。
caption.en: The loop, temple form: the model reads the request and gives one JSON action a turn; the last picture rides into the next turn; 6,000 tokens, 12,000 on an empty answer; a 7 s pause on 429.

caption.zh: 权限：模型只能从目录选工具和参数；.blend 由 driver 给，模型永远不能指定；参数拼成 argv 列表，从不经过 shell。
caption.en: Permissions: the model picks only tools and arguments the catalog knows; the .blend is supplied by the driver, never by the model; arguments become an argv list, never a shell string.

caption.zh: 工具前的 hook：--flag 前缀剥掉，skill/tool 拆开，未知参数按名拒绝，缺输入文件就把运行文件夹的清单回给模型。
caption.en: Hook before the tool: flag prefixes stripped, skill/tool split, an unknown argument refused by name, a missing input answered with the run folder's listing.

caption.zh: 技能架上取 model-anatomy：inventory 写 anatomy.json（角色、种类、尺寸、地标、相机），bearing 写 bearing.json（谁托着谁、悬空、重叠、阶段）。
caption.en: model-anatomy off the shelf: inventory writes anatomy.json (roles, kinds, extents, landmarks, cameras); bearing writes bearing.json (what rests on what, floating, overlaps, stages).

caption.zh: 工具：Blender 子进程跑脚本，上限 3600 秒，回传退出码和最后 4,000 字。实测：小楼 inventory 0.5 秒；大殿 8,170 件 10 秒，bearing 6,264 件 81 秒，36 个阶段。
caption.en: Tool: a Blender subprocess runs the script, 3600 s ceiling, returning the exit code and the last 4,000 characters. Measured: inventory 0.5 s on the stack; on the hall 10 s for 8,170 pieces, bearing 81 s for 6,264 pieces, 36 stages.

caption.zh: 工具后的 hook：新文件列出来，新图附给下一轮；这一步没有图。
caption.en: Hook after the tool: new files are listed and a new picture attached to the next turn; this tool makes no picture.

caption.zh: shot-judge 是目录里的一个工具，模型必须对每张要留的图调用它；这条路上没有图，它只是待命。
caption.en: shot-judge is a catalog tool the model must call on every picture it keeps; this journey makes no picture, so it stands by.

caption.zh: 停之前的 hook：两次读不懂的回答就停；动作上限（默认 40，基准用 12）就停；任何异常也以记录的 stop 结束。没有自动修复：工具的拒绝原话就是模型下一轮读到的。
caption.en: Hook before stopping: two unreadable answers stop it; the action cap (40 by default, 12 in the benchmarks) stops it; any exception ends in a recorded stop. Nothing is repaired automatically: the tool's own refusal is what the model reads next.

steps.log: Stop  cap 40  unreadable x2  exception -> stop

caption.zh: Transcript：每个事件追加到 events.jsonl 和这次运行的 ledger.jsonl——阶段、技能、事件种类、输入哈希、图的路径、token；页面用 SSE 流同样的事件，每秒一次心跳。
caption.en: Transcript: every event appended to events.jsonl and the run's ledger.jsonl, stage, skill, kind, input hash, picture path, tokens; the page streams the same events with a one-second heartbeat.

caption.zh: Evals：小楼基准——有技能 3 步 0.5 秒答完；裸模型 bearing 9 步 88 秒没答完。
caption.en: Evals: on the stack, with the skill 3 actions and 0.5 s to an answer; bare, bearing took 9 actions and 88 s without finishing.

steps.log: Evals  skills 3 acts 0.5 s | bare 9 acts 88 s unfinished

request.zh: 「把正面左起第二根柱头的斗拱拆开，看看榫卯怎么咬合」
request.en: "Take apart the bracket set on the second column from the left along the front and show how its joints lock"

caption.zh: 「把正面左起第二根柱头的斗拱拆开，看看榫卯怎么咬合」——POST /api/runs 开一次运行。
caption.en: "Take apart the bracket set on the second column from the left along the front and show how its joints lock": POST /api/runs opens a run.

steps.log: Request  POST /api/runs  how the joints lock

caption.zh: 常驻：协议和技能索引。索引里 joint-reveal 的描述写明三种榫卯刻在哪一组斗拱上（Column -12.50 -8.83）；全文在第一次用到时装入。
caption.en: Always loaded: the protocol and the skills index. joint-reveal's description names the set its three joints are cut on (Column -12.50 -8.83); the full text loads on first use.

steps.log: Memory  protocol + index  joint-reveal names its set

caption.zh: 主循环：StepFun 的 Step 3.7 Flash 先试了一次 explode，参数写错被退回；读到全文后先清点构件（10.6 秒），再算谁托着谁（107.5 秒）。
caption.en: The loop: StepFun's Step 3.7 Flash first tried explode with a wrong argument and was refused; with the full text read, it took stock of the pieces (10.6 s) and worked out what rests on what (107.5 s).

steps.log: Loop  step-3.7-flash  think: inventory, bearing, joints, explode

caption.zh: 工具前的 hook：参数检查。要几个值的参数一次读一组，一对构件名不会再被拆成单个字母；该给文件的地方写了“是”就略去；给了 joints.json 的工具改在刻好榫卯的副本上跑。
caption.en: The hook before a tool: the arguments are checked. A flag that takes several values reads one list per use, so a pair of piece names is never split into letters again; a yes where a file belongs is left out; a tool given joints.json runs on the copy the joints were cut into.

caption.zh: 技能架上取 joint-reveal：joints 在派生副本上刻出三种真榫卯（柱头馒头榫、十字搭交、燕尾），explode 在刻好的副本上用 Blender 素色视图拍成片：先看斗拱在殿里的位置，再逐个近看每个榫卯拆开又扣回，配字幕。对这组斗拱，一次 explode 也能自己刻好再拍。
caption.en: joint-reveal off the shelf: joints cuts the three real joints on a derived copy (the column-top tenon, the cross-lap, the dovetail), and explode films them on that copy in Blender's plain look: the set in its hall, then each joint close, coming apart and locking again, captioned. For this set one explode can also cut them itself and film them.

caption.zh: 工具：Blender，在 Spark 的显卡上渲染。实测（StepFun 现场）：JOINTS 3 用 3.7 秒；EXPLODE 3 个榫卯、630 帧、45.0 秒。
caption.en: The tool: Blender, rendering on the Spark's chip. Measured live on StepFun: JOINTS 3 in 3.7 s; EXPLODE 3 joints, 630 frames, 45.0 s.

line.zh: 01 act joint-reveal explode 3 个榫卯 · 45.0 s

steps.log: Tool  blender  joints.py 3.7 s | explode.py  3 joints  630 frames  45.0 s

caption.zh: 工具后的 hook：每个榫卯拆开时的定格 joint-<kind>.png 和成片 explode.mp4 附给下一轮。
caption.en: The hook after a tool: each joint's held-open still, joint-<kind>.png, and the film explode.mp4 go to the next turn.

caption.zh: shot-judge 另开一次调用看十字搭交那张，同样是 Step 3.7 Flash：两件分开、一橙一蓝、卯口看得见——通过（8.6 秒）。定格本来就是拆开的样子；技能说明教模型按“两件分开”去问，不再要它合上。
caption.en: shot-judge looks at the cross-lap still in a call of its own, on Step 3.7 Flash too: two pieces held apart, one orange and one blue, the notch showing: a pass (8.6 s). The still is the joint opened on purpose; the skill teaches the model to ask for that, not for the joint assembled.

caption.zh: 停之前的 hook：判官通过，一张过了就交付，不再补拍近景；一次读不出的回答只重试一次，好回答之后重新计数。
caption.en: The hook before stopping: the judge passed, and one pass is the answer, with no closeups after it; an unreadable reply is retried once, and the count starts again after a good one.

caption.zh: Transcript：act 事件带文件、图、秒数和工具尾巴；这次 StepFun 现场运行 15 步、204 秒、33,401 token，成片在页面上放大。
caption.en: Transcript: each act carries its files, picture, seconds and the tool's tail; this live run on StepFun took 15 steps, 204 s and 33,401 tokens, and its film goes large on the page.

caption.zh: Evals：小楼基准——有技能六道题全答完，裸模型两道；拆开这一题有技能 11 步答完，裸模型撞上限。
caption.en: Evals: on the stack benchmark, all six tasks answered with the skills against two bare; this take-apart task took 11 acts with the skill, and the bare model hit the cap.

request.zh: 「带我里里外外看一遍这座大殿」
request.en: "Take me round the hall, inside and out"

caption.zh: 「带我里里外外看一遍这座大殿」——POST /api/runs。
caption.en: "Take me round the hall, inside and out": POST /api/runs.

steps.log: Request  POST /api/runs  tour inside and out

caption.en: Standing: the protocol and index; structure-tour loads on use.

caption.zh: 主循环：模型选了 structure-tour；先清点构件，再一个工具四段镜头。
caption.en: The loop: the model chose structure-tour; inventory first, then one tool with four camera moves.

caption.zh: 工具前的 hook：segments 必须是逗号分隔的字符串，不是 JSON 列表——第一次基准就撞过这一条。
caption.en: Hook before the tool: segments must be a comma-separated string, not a JSON list; the first benchmark run hit exactly that.

steps.log: PreCheck  segments: comma list, not JSON

caption.zh: 技能架上取 structure-tour：outside 绕圈，door 走近，inside 藏墙走进去抬头看，overhead 掀掉屋面和椽子俯视。
caption.en: structure-tour off the shelf: outside orbits, door approaches, inside walks in with the walls hidden and tilts up, overhead looks down with the covering and rafters hidden.

steps.log: Skill  structure-tour  tour: outside, door, inside, overhead

caption.zh: 工具：Blender，上限 3600 秒。实测大殿：TOUR 4 段 480 帧 1,353 秒，16 秒成片；小楼基准 211.8 秒。
caption.en: Tool: Blender, 3600 s ceiling. Measured on the hall: TOUR 4 segments, 480 frames, 1,353 s, a 16 s film; on the stack 211.8 s.

steps.log: Tool  blender  tour.py  1353 s  tour.mp4 + 4 stills

caption.zh: 工具后的 hook：四张定格附上；渲染时页面的心跳数 tour 文件夹里落下的帧。
caption.en: Hook after the tool: four stills attached; while rendering, the page's heartbeat counts frames landing in the tour folder.

steps.log: PostCheck  stills: outside, door, inside, overhead

caption.zh: shot-judge 逐张看，每段写明想看什么。大殿上 outside、door、overhead 过了，inside 因灯光不合格。
caption.en: shot-judge looks at each still against what it was meant to show. On the hall outside, door and overhead passed; inside failed on lighting.

caption.zh: 停之前的 hook：不合格的那段由模型重渲——outside 不过多半要更大半径，inside 不过要更低的镜头；每张最多三次。
caption.en: Hook before stopping: the failed segment is re-rendered by the model; a fail on outside usually wants a wider radius, on inside a lower camera; three attempts per shot.

caption.zh: 回到主循环：只重渲 inside 一段，551 秒后通过。
caption.en: Back to the loop: only the inside segment is re-rendered, passing after 551 s.

caption.zh: Transcript：每个 think、act、look、final、stop 一行，记进 events.jsonl 与 ledger.jsonl。
caption.en: Transcript: a line per think, act, look, final and stop in events.jsonl and ledger.jsonl.

caption.zh: Evals：小楼基准——修复后有技能 10 步答完，4 张判 1 张过，279 秒；裸模型撞上限。

steps.log: Evals  skills answered 279 s | bare cap

request.en: "Build the hall from nothing to the ridge"

caption.zh: 「把大殿从零盖到屋脊」——POST /api/runs。
caption.en: "Build the hall from nothing to the ridge": POST /api/runs.

caption.zh: 常驻：协议、索引；raise-the-hall 全文用到才装。
caption.en: Standing: protocol and index; raise-the-hall on use.

caption.zh: 主循环：模型选了 raise-the-hall；协议要求 inventory 和 bearing 都先跑——顺序来自实测的承托关系。
caption.en: The loop: the model chose raise-the-hall; the protocol requires both inventory and bearing first, since the order comes from the measured bearing.

steps.log: Loop  think: inventory, bearing, stages, raise

caption.zh: 工具前的 hook：stages 缺一个位置参数就按名拒绝——第一次实跑正撞上这一条，模型读到拒绝后补上。
caption.en: Hook before the tool: stages refuses a missing positional by name; the first driven run hit exactly that, and the model read the refusal and supplied it.

steps.log: PreCheck  stages: missing positional refused by name

caption.zh: 技能架上取 raise-the-hall：stages 把 36 个阶段并成至多 24 幕并命名；raise 让每件从上方到位，镜头绕行。
caption.en: raise-the-hall off the shelf: stages merges 36 bearing stages into at most 24 named scenes; raise brings each piece in from above while the camera orbits.

caption.zh: 工具：stages 是普通 Python，120 秒上限；raise 是 Blender。实测大殿：SCENES 24 from 36，RAISE 24 幕 311 帧 826 秒；小楼 136.5 秒。
caption.en: Tool: stages is plain Python, 120 s ceiling; raise is Blender. Measured on the hall: SCENES 24 from 36, RAISE 24 scenes 311 frames in 826 s; on the stack 136.5 s.

steps.log: Tool  python stages.py | blender raise.py  826 s

caption.zh: 工具后的 hook：每幕一张定格附上；心跳读 scenes.json 估算总帧数。
caption.en: Hook after the tool: a still per scene attached; the heartbeat reads scenes.json to estimate the frame count.

caption.zh: shot-judge 看最后一张（带屋顶的成殿）和中间一张（半建的木架，无屋顶）。大殿上最后一张因取景不合格：绕行半径 1.15 倍，太近。
caption.en: shot-judge looks at the last still (the finished hall with its roof) and a middle one (the half-built frame, no roof). On the hall the last still failed on framing at an orbit of 1.15 times the building, too close.

caption.zh: 停之前的 hook：判官的话回主循环，模型把半径放到 1.45 倍重渲。
caption.en: Hook before stopping: the judge's words go back to the loop; the model re-renders at 1.45 times.

caption.zh: 回到主循环：296 帧、799 秒，通过，判官没再要求改动。
caption.en: Back to the loop: 296 frames, 799 s, pass, with no change asked.

caption.en: Transcript: events.jsonl and ledger.jsonl; this is the run the exhibit's Build it button replays.

steps.log: Memory  protocol + index  load-path names its joint

caption.zh: 主循环：StepFun 的 Step 3.7 Flash 先清点构件（10.7 秒），算谁托着谁（bearing，108.1 秒），再称一遍重量（weights，7.1 秒）——连锁倒塌按这张承托表一环一环走。

steps.log: Loop  step-3.7-flash  think: inventory, bearing, weights, collapse

caption.en: Transcript: this live run on StepFun took 10 steps, 192 s and 18,264 tokens; its film goes large on the page.

request.zh: 「照着还站着的那座大殿，从一个空文件盖一座，过了重力测试再交」
request.en: "From an empty file, build a hall to match the temple that still stands, and hand it over only when it passes the gravity test"

caption.zh: 「从一个空文件盖一座大殿，照着还站着的那座，过了重力测试再交」——POST /api/runs 开一次运行。模型拿到的只有一个空文件和一座可以量的庙。
caption.en: "From an empty file, build a hall to match the temple that still stands, and hand it over only when it passes the gravity test": POST /api/runs opens a run. The model is given an empty file and a building it may measure.

steps.log: Request  POST /api/runs  rebuild the hall from nothing

caption.zh: 常驻：协议和技能索引；hall-carpenter 的全文在第一次用到时装入。它的第一句话是条规矩——你从不写 3D 代码。
caption.en: Standing: the protocol and the skill index; hall-carpenter's full text loads on first use. Its first line is a rule: you never write 3D code.

steps.log: Memory  protocol + index  hall-carpenter loaded on use

caption.zh: 主循环：每轮一个 JSON 动作，结果和图回给模型。动作上限 80；第四次重建用掉 71 个——17 个放构件、5 次读、3 次失败。
caption.en: The loop: one JSON action a turn, with the result and any picture shown back. The cap is 80 actions; the fourth rebuild used 71 of them, 17 placing, 5 reads and 3 that failed.

steps.log: Loop  cap 80  one JSON action a turn

caption.zh: 工具前的 hook：目录检查参数，负数坐标要写成 --xs=-4,0,4，否则被当成选项。每个工具只按给它的数字放一个构件，放在告诉它的地方，不是放在合适的地方——高度给错就悬着或陷进去，检查会找出来。
caption.en: Hook before the tool: the catalog checks the arguments, and a negative coordinate must be written --xs=-4,0,4 or it reads as an option. Each tool places one part from the numbers it is given, where it is told and not where it would fit: a height given wrong leaves the piece hanging or sunk, and the checks find it.

steps.log: PreCheck  args normalised  all numbers in metres

caption.zh: 技能架上取 hall-carpenter：survey 先把还站着的庙量成一页数字，然后按承重顺序往上——台基、柱、额枋、墙、斗拱、梁架、桁檩、椽、屋面。每个工具打印它做出的高度，下一个构件用打印出来的高度，不用猜的。
caption.en: hall-carpenter off the shelf: survey measures the standing temple into a sheet of numbers, then the parts go up in carrying order, platform, columns, tie beams, walls, bracket sets, roof frames, purlins, rafters, covering. Each tool prints the heights it made, and the next part uses those printed heights rather than a guess.

steps.log: Skill  hall-carpenter  survey, platform, columns ... roof

caption.zh: 工具：Blender 子进程跑脚本，只有 bpy、numpy 和标准库，不联网。放完一座三千三百件的大殿只要几秒，检查要两到三分钟。再放一次同一个构件就是替换，所以「修」就是同一个工具换更好的数字。
caption.en: Tool: a Blender subprocess runs the script with bpy, numpy and the standard library only, and no network. Placing every part of a 3,300-piece hall takes seconds; the checks take two to three minutes. Placing a part again replaces it, so a repair is the same tool with better numbers.

caption.zh: 工具后的 hook：六项检查读这座楼自己的文件——清点、谁托着谁、每根柱吃多少力、放手三秒看掉不掉、地动之后再横推、以及像不像。顺序也管：清点、承托、放手必须依次跑，每一步读上一步的结果；横推要在承托之后。检查找到的毛病一行跟着结果回来，不等模型来问。
caption.en: Hook after the tool: six checks read the hall's own files, an inventory, what rests on what, how much each column carries, letting every piece go for three seconds, shaking the ground and then pulling sideways, and how alike the two buildings are. Order counts: inventory, bearing and settle must run in that order, each reading the one before, and the shake after the bearing. The fault report's line comes back with the result instead of waiting for the model to ask.

steps.log: PostCheck  bearing, weights, settle, shake, likeness

caption.zh: 另一双眼睛：shot-judge 单独看那张并排的图，自带提示词，不带这次运行的历史。第四次重建它一次就放过；第三次看了三回——不过、不过、通过。
caption.en: A separate pair of eyes: shot-judge looks at the side-by-side picture on its own, with its own prompt and none of the run's history. On the fourth rebuild it passed at the first look; on the third it took three, fail, fail, pass.

caption.zh: 停之前的 hook：交不交由 harness 决定，不由模型说了算。模型说做完了，就去读运行文件夹；只要有一项检查没跑、比最后一次改动旧、或者没过，就退回去，理由当作模型的下一轮。修理圈数和退回次数 harness 自己数，所以绕圈的模型被一个它争不过的数字拦住。
caption.en: Hook before stopping: whether the hall may be handed over is the harness's decision, not the model's. When the model says it has finished, the run folder is read, and the hand-over is refused while any check is missing, older than the last change to the hall, or failed; the reasons go back as the model's next turn. The harness counts the repair laps and the refusals itself, so a model that loops is stopped by a number it cannot argue with.

line.zh: 04 gate 第 6 圈，共 6 圈

steps.log: Stop  adoption gate  6 checks + the eyes

caption.zh: 回到主循环再修一圈。被采纳要同时满足：没有构件悬空，放手后没有掉落或移位，三个方向的影子都够像且每根柱都在位，框架也像——柱头的额枋、屋面的桁檩、正脊和椽子、每根柱上一朵斗拱；再加上没有一根柱超过木头能承的力，以及地动加横推之后没有构件掉下来。
caption.en: Back to the loop for another repair lap. Adopted means all of it: nothing hanging, nothing fallen or shifted when every piece was let go, the three shadows sharing enough of the temple's outline with every column in its place, and the frame like the temple's, tie beams at the column heads, the roof rings, ridge and rafters, a bracket set on every column, plus no column carrying more than its timber can bear, and nothing coming down when the ground shakes and the hall is pulled sideways.

line.en: 05 adopted  36 of 36 tie spans, 36 of 36 bracket sets

caption.zh: Transcript：每个事件追加到 events.jsonl 和这次运行的 ledger.jsonl；成绩单事后从运行文件夹自己的文件里读，从不读模型对这些文件的说法。
caption.en: Transcript: every event appended to events.jsonl and the run's own ledger.jsonl; the scorecard is read afterwards from the run folder's files, never from what the model said about them.

steps.log: Transcript  events.jsonl + ledger.jsonl  scorecard from files

caption.zh: Evals：四次从零重建。前三次在四项检查的旧门槛下——一次没被采纳（6 件悬空、26 件掉落），一次被错误地采纳（后来补的检查发现 2 件穿过屋顶），一次通过。加了三项检查之后的第四次，4,255 件里 0 件悬空、0 件掉落，最重的柱子 8.08 MPa（上限 10），花掉一百万 token。没有裸模型对照：没有这个技能，就没有能放木头的工具，无从比起。
caption.en: Evals: four rebuilds from nothing. The first three ran under the old gate of four checks: one not adopted, with 6 pieces hanging and 26 fallen; one adopted wrongly, where a check added afterwards found 2 pieces through the roof; one adopted. Under the three added checks the fourth had 0 hanging and 0 fallen of 4,255 pieces and its heaviest column at 8.08 MPa of the 10 allowed, for a million tokens. There is no bare-model row: without the skill there is no tool that places timber, so there is nothing to compare.

line.zh: 06 benchmark 第四次重建 采纳
